semiconductor_relevance: High — Wingzhen Technology specializes in equipment installation and maintenance for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wingzhen Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based company focused on the installation and maintenance of dry etching and CVD equipment for the semiconductor industry. Established in 2012, the company also provides maintenance services for vacuum valves, RF systems, and turbo molecular pumps, along with CMP consumer parts and head overhauls.
capabilities: Installation and maintenance of TFT/IC dry etching and CVD equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen City, China.
